overview.text: The Steppe (or Dione's) Rat Snake is a harmless rat snake of eastern Europe and Asia, from Ukraine to Korea.

size.label: Adults
size.text: A large one from Putyatin Island, Russia, measured about 90 cm.

distribution.label: Native
distribution.text: Eastern Ukraine, southern Russia and the Russian Far East, the Caucasus, Central Asia, northern Iran, Afghanistan, Mongolia, northern China and Korea.

habitat.text: Forest, shrubland, grassland, rocky places, desert, wetlands and disturbed land, from sea level to about 3,580 m.

reproduction.text: Wikipedia describes females laying 3 to 15 eggs (rarely up to 24) in July or August; the Reptile Database lists it as live-bearing, so sources disagree.

recognise.text: Medium-sized rat snake of steppes and open land.
